data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund of €428
data.summary: The tax office (Finanzamt) Neu-Beispielstadt issued your income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 on 15 June 2026. It results in a refund of €428.00, to be paid into your bank account.
data.explanation: This is your final income tax calculation for 2025. You paid more wage tax (€4,406) than the tax due (€3,978), so you get €428 back. The money is transferred to the account named in the letter, so check that the IBAN is yours. Compare the figures with your tax return. The letter notes that commuting allowance was applied for 196 working days and a daily home office flat rate for the other days. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the office. The app shows until when. If you don't object, the assessment becomes final. A tax adviser or income tax help association can assist.
